text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek, you look to be in high spirits.<n>Did anything
fortunate happen to<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What do you think happened? I want<n>to hear your
best guess. If you can<n>get it right, I'll give you
something<n>real nice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...For someone still in training such as<n>myself, I
have nary an inkling of the<n>answer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet, if your current mood is this jovial,<n>then I am
certain that something truly<n>wonderful must have
transpired.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the correct answer is your<n>birthday, Yaeno.
You might've gotten<n>it wrong, but I'll still give you
your<n>present. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Creek, my birthday brings you this<n>much joy?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have always recognized you as a<n>rival I must
strive to defeat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I believed that one day, I would<n>harness all my
power... and strike you<n>down with the mind and
body I had<n>honed. That was my view of our
relationship...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you wish to tell me that such<n>an
opponent's birthday brings you<n>great contentment?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course, silly. ♪ I've prepared plenty<n>of cake and
other treats for you, so<n>be sure to eat a lot so you
can grow<n>big and strong, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see, so you would wait for me to<n>grow strong
enough for our inevitable<n>clash. In that case... I shall
gladly<n>accept your generosity!
